description: This file contains platform-specific functions for image verification, upgrade procedures, and configuration copying for various hardware boards in an OpenWrt-based system.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether a given firmware image is valid for the current hardware and partition layout.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a system upgrade based on the hardware specifications and image type.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies or backs up device configuration data depending on the boot device type.
